sections.heading: 1. Earth as a System — the Biosphere
points: The Earth is a **system** of interacting parts: **lithosphere (land), hydrosphere (water), atmosphere (air)** and **biosphere (life)**.
The **biosphere** is the life-supporting zone where the three physical spheres meet.
**Energy** (mainly from the **Sun**) flows through, and **matter** cycles within, this system.

sections.heading: 2. Flow of Energy and Food Chains
points: A **food chain** links these; many chains form a **food web**.
Only about **10%** of energy passes to the next **trophic level** (the '10% law'), so chains are short.

sections.heading: 3. Biogeochemical Cycles
points: Matter is **recycled** through nature via biogeochemical cycles:

sub: **Carbon cycle** — photosynthesis (fixes CO₂) and respiration/combustion (release CO₂).
**Nitrogen cycle** — nitrogen fixed by bacteria/lightning → plants → animals → decomposers → back to air.
**Oxygen cycle** — released by photosynthesis, used in respiration/combustion.

sections.heading: 4. The Ozone Layer and Human Impact
points: The **ozone (O₃) layer** in the stratosphere shields life from harmful **ultraviolet (UV)** rays; harmed by **CFCs** (ozone hole).
Human activities cause **pollution (air, water, soil)**, **global warming** (rising greenhouse gases), and loss of biodiversity.
**Sustainable use** and conservation are needed to keep the Earth system in balance.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Earth spheres: lithosphere, hydrosphere, atmosphere, biosphere (life zone).
Energy flows one way (Sun → producers → consumers → decomposers); only ~10% to next level.
Biogeochemical cycles: water, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen — recycle matter.
Ozone layer (stratosphere) blocks UV rays; harmed by CFCs.
Human impact: pollution, global warming (greenhouse gases), biodiversity loss.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Energy flows one way** and **decreases** (~10% law) at each trophic level; **matter is recycled**.
The **ozone layer** is in the **stratosphere** and blocks **UV** rays; **CFCs** damage it.
In the **carbon cycle**, **photosynthesis fixes CO₂** and **respiration/combustion release** it.
The **biosphere** is where land, water and air overlap to support life.
